parse.wikitext:
{{Has calculator|Calculator:Fishing/Aerial fishing}}
[[File:Cormorant's glove equipped.png|thumb|A player with a cormorant's glove equipped|300x300px]]
'''Aerial fishing''' is a hybrid [[Fishing]] and [[Hunter]] technique requiring 35 Hunter and 43 Fishing. The aerial fishing technique is used to catch several [[fish]] species at [[Lake Molch]].  

Hunters can get a [[cormorant's glove]] and a cormorant, free of charge, from the fishing expert [[Alry the Angler]] at [[Lake Molch]]. Both hands must be free for aerial fishing, which means no items may be carried in the weapon, shield, or hands slots. It is possible to use [[Temporary skill boost|skill boosts]] to receive a [[cormorant's glove]], which will allow players to catch [[bluegill]] even if their level(s) drain back to normal. 

With a cormorant's glove equipped, and a suitable reward (such as [[King worm|king worms]], [[fish offcuts]], or [[fine fish offcuts]]) for the cormorant in their [[inventory]], players may send the cormorant out to catch a fish. The cormorant will always return to the player with a fish.
